reviewer: Independent implementation agent complete_asset; actual rendered image inspection
captureContext: Actual Three.js/WebGL Chromium rendering of the existing model on the Practice development route. Candidate C was substituted only in the pose-library network response; model and pose were not replaced by a photograph.

decision.scope: C Major candidate only. Anatomical visual plausibility is separate from numerical contact/collision approval, realistic texture fidelity and physical iPad Safari approval.
decision.finalReviewReason: Local wrist/digit plausibility and zero collision do not establish the full reference requirement. An independent C-pose review still flags an elongated hand silhouette and exposed finite forearm crop that can appear to float.

observations: Five distinct human digits with jointed, curved finger shapes are visible across the four views. No detached wrist, gross folded skin, duplicate digit or obvious self-crossing is visible.
The thumb remains behind the wooden neck in the rear view; it does not cross over the fingerboard.
The hand, wrist and genuine continuous forearm remain connected; the charcoal garment is a continuous cloth panel over the forearm.
The +25 degree forearm direction change and compensating wrist rotation look plausible in these views. No gross wrist pinch is visible.
Default camera places the headstock upper right and shows the fingerboard. The low-E/top order is checked separately by the camera tests.

The fret-contact finger arrangement is unchanged from the contact-refined candidate within 0.0000072 mm for vertices without forearm influence. Precise string clearance is supported by the separate geometric audits, not inferred from pixels.
limitations: The final conservative project decision keeps C needs-review: the silhouette is still elongated relative to the supplied reference and the finite arm end remains visible. This independent local-plausibility review must not be used alone to promote the runtime teaching pose.
The original finite forearm crop remains visible from Side/Player views. It is not a completed elbow/torso or a full photorealistic musician.
The default hand is still smaller and less photographic than the supplied reference; broad lighting and absent skin normal detail reduce realism.
These rendered frames do not replace the exact triangle contact/collision audit. They do not certify the other 41 chord poses.
Linux Chromium inspection does not establish approval on physical iPad Safari.
